title: Closing and Funding Late-Funding Prepaid Interest Refund
content:
## The refund

A late-funding refund returns the prepaid interest a funded Closing and Funding closing collected for days on which its loan was not yet funded. The refund is owed as soon as the loan has funded and is booked within the per diem refund business days; its booking date is the day it is booked. A charge that already carries a late-funding refund is not refunded again for funding late.

The refund entry names the charge collected at closing that it corrects, records the daily amount used, records its period as the refunded days counted back from the day before the disbursement date, and carries the late-funding refund, any interest added because the refund is booked late included, as its amount.

## How the booking tool is invoked

The refund is booked with the agent-side tool `refund_late_funding_interest_1de244fe`: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call adds one refund entry, marked as a refund for funding later than estimated, to the closing's prepaid interest ledger, dated today, and lowers the closing's prepaid interest balance by the refund amount in the same step. The borrower can see the refund entry and the lower prepaid interest balance.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `closing_id` | reference number of the closing and funding engagement whose prepaid interest is refunded, as returned by the closing lookup | identifier |
| `source_interest_entry_id` | reference number of the prepaid interest charge entry this refund corrects, as returned by the prepaid interest ledger lookup for that closing | identifier |
| `interest_from_date` | earliest refunded day of interest | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_through_date` | latest refunded day of interest; the same as the earliest refunded day when a single day is refunded | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `daily_interest_amount` | per diem amount at which each refunded day is returned | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `interest_amount` | total refund amount, any interest added for a late booking included | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive figure rounded half up to the cent |

The tool records the number of refunded days itself, counting both ends of the period.

## Return

A confirmation naming the new refund entry reference number, the closing reference number, the refunded period with its day count, the per diem amount, the refund amount and the closing's resulting prepaid interest balance. The presence of the new entry reference number indicates the refund was booked.

## Recording the period (hypothetical)

With a disbursement date of the 20th and 3 refunded days, the period is counted back from the 19th: the earliest refunded day is the 17th and the latest is the 19th. With 1 refunded day, both dates are the 19th.
